topic.title: AI Integration with the New File Creation Wizard

body.p: The AI Positron is integrated with Oxygen's new document creation wizard. The file creation dialog box contains a text area input box where you can provide the AI details and instructions for creating a new document from the chosen file template. You can also paste snippets of content, paste or drop files (text, Markdown, Word, PDF), and paste or drop images. The AI will use the information to create a new document of the chosen file type with content pre-populated.
